newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products mixed,gasoline up on Nigeria dema.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products mixed,gasoline up on Nigeria dema.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were mixed on Monday, traders said.

Gas oil prices were steady at the lower levels encouraged by relatively stable gas oil futures but lengthy supplies of 0.2 sulphur material pegged premiums to benchmark quotes back to around +$1.50/$2 a tonne cif Genoa.
Traders said prompt requirements for diesel were prompting slightly firmer premiums due to tightening supplies but business was still fairly thin for both grades.
Gasoline strengthened in the Mediterranean relative to NWE as Nigerian demand impacted. Traders said premium unleaded cargoes were pegged at $193 cif Med about $2 stronger than NWE.
High sulphur was steady with incoming buying interest seen supportive. Low Russian avails on the market were also giving support.

A seller said he was finding difficulty moving his Russian M-100 cargo and was offering it at two means, but a Spanish refiner was said to be looking for bunker spec material and two other buyers were heard on the market.
One percent was said to be well balanced with an Italian buyer still in need of material.
"The market may have come off a little from last week's highs but it is steady now. One buyer still needs to do a fair amount of buying," one trader said.
